premises.text: Traditional remittances force recipients through agency travel and waits while senders pay high fees such as Western Union charges up to 10%
premises.evidence_span: They have to pay for a bus to go to an agency, wait online for two hours, then go to another agency to pay their utility bills

premises.text: Immigrants send SMS-delivered mobile credit that recipients spend like a gift card on food, medicine, utilities, and tuition
premises.evidence_span: send a credit directly to their family cell phone in Latin America that could be used to pay for food, medicine, utility bills, even tuition

premises.text: Senders can buy online or at 200 partner mom-and-pop stores; recipients get an SMS PIN and can transfer funds onward, making the network viral
premises.evidence_span: visit us offline at one of 200 partner mom and pop stores

premises.text: Contracts give access to 7,200 retail locations in eight countries where retailers pay fees that subsidize a flat $3 customer fee
premises.evidence_span: we already have the contracts that gives us access to 7,200 retail locations in eight different countries

premises.text: Latin America remittance market is large and mostly spent on food and utilities, enabling scale beyond one NYC neighborhood corridor
premises.evidence_span: scale into the rest of Latin America, which receives $69 billion in remittances each year

domains.name: retail network and flat fee economics

value.text: Immigrants pay for family's basic needs back home via SMS without agency hassle and at much lower fees
value.evidence_span: allow immigrants to pay for all of their family's basic needs back home, all via an SMS

causal_links.evidence_span: Western Union taxes them up to 10%. That's insane
unique SMS pin code that she can use to pay for food at the local supermarket
a low flat fee of just $3, up to 70% cheaper than any alternative
64% of that is already being spent on food and utility bills

notes: Agency bus/wait/utility and WU fee folded as one remittance pain set (§4.1.6). SMS credit, PIN/gift-card spend, onward transfer/virality, and mom-and-pop send folded into product/channel surface. Retailer-fee subsidy of $3 is commercial mechanism with contract footprint. Traction metrics excluded; $3.4B opportunity framing inside market premise. 'Future of remittances'/'social network' aspiration not a separate premise (§4.1.4).
